original_completion_criteria.criterion: Full scoped audit performed with evidence, and no confirmed in-scope repairable defect knowingly left without disposition.
Source fixes independently tested with meaningful negative controls; E10 integrity intact.
Independent Tester and Reviewer command comparison accepted, with final Planner original-criteria map.
All applicable final checkout/extraction suites have accurate outcomes; no hidden mandatory failures.
Frozen governance unchanged; no unauthorized actions, false identity/OS sandbox claims or historical evidence rewriting.
Release package/checksum verified, installation instructions coherent, and local Git checkpoint finalized if changes were made.
Gate 3 separately and truthfully classified as verified/failed/blocked/unverified per its frozen evidence rules, rather than treated as a release-test checkbox.

assessment_rules.PASS: Required observable work has sufficient evidence; honest host limits may be the required disposition where Owner permits them.
assessment_rules.FAIL: Positive evidence contradicts a mandatory required behavior or work remains defective.
assessment_rules.BLOCKED: A mandatory deliverable cannot be completed due to a demonstrated external/capability/authorization/resource dependency.
assessment_rules.UNVERIFIED: Evidence is insufficient; do not infer pass/fail.
assessment_rules.status_at_publication: All work items await execution; no prospective PASS.
